terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing or using Orxis, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. These terms are written to be clear and practical.

sections.heading: 1. The Service
paragraphs: Orxis provides a structured AI custom instruction generator. You provide information about your desired AI persona, task, tone, and constraints; the service returns a structured instruction prompt designed to improve AI consistency and adherence.

The underlying AI model is provided by a third-party API (currently Google Gemini). The quality, accuracy, and behaviour of that model are outside our control. We are not responsible for outputs produced by the underlying model.

sections.heading: 2. Your Responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for how you use the outputs generated by Orxis. The prompts produced by this service are tools — their suitability for a given task, and the consequences of deploying them, are your determination to make.
You agree not to use Orxis to generate instructions for:
list: Harmful, deceptive, or illegal AI behaviour
Impersonation of real individuals or entities
Generating content that violates applicable laws in your jurisdiction
Circumventing safety measures in AI systems

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: Orxis is a free service supported by the community. To ensure fair access for everyone, you agree not to:
list: Automate or script mass requests to the generation endpoint
Attempt to circumvent, reverse engineer, or exploit the API infrastructure
Use the service in any way that degrades performance for other users
Submit content to the Community Gallery that infringes third-party rights or violates applicable law
sections.afterList: We reserve the right to block access for users or IP addresses that violate these terms, without prior notice.

sections.heading: 4. Service Availability
paragraphs: Orxis is hosted on Vercel and depends on third-party infrastructure including database and AI API services. We aim for high availability and make reasonable efforts to maintain uptime. However, we cannot guarantee uninterrupted service. Downtime may occur due to:
list: Scheduled maintenance
Third-party infrastructure outages
Circumstances outside our reasonable control
sections.afterList: We are not liable for any losses or damages caused by service interruption.

paragraphs: The Orxis application — including its UI design, source code, prompt generation framework, and all associated intellectual property — is proprietary. The generated prompt text that you produce belongs to you. See our <1>License page</1> for a full breakdown.

We do not warrant that the service will be error-free, uninterrupted, or that outputs will meet your expectations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Orxis is a browser-based AI instruction generator. This policy explains what information we handle, how we handle it, and why. It is written to be readable, not to overwhelm you. If you have questions, contact us at <1>orxis.app@gmail.com</1>.

sections.heading: 1. What We Collect
paragraphs: By default, Orxis operates on the client side. When you use the generator, your inputs — persona, task, tone, and rules — are processed in your browser or sent directly to the underlying language model API. We do not log, store, or transmit your raw inputs to our own servers.

The one exception: if you choose to submit a generated prompt to the Community Gallery, the submission content (title, category, tags, description, and prompt text) is stored in our database. This is a deliberate, voluntary action on your part.

sections.heading: 2. What We Do Not Collect
list: The text of your generated instructions, unless you explicitly submit them to the Gallery
Account or profile information — we do not require sign-up to use the generator
Payment or financial data of any kind
Device fingerprints or persistent tracking identifiers

sections.heading: 3. Analytics
paragraphs: We may use standard, anonymized analytics tools to understand how the application is used at a functional level — for example, which pages are visited and general usage patterns. This data is aggregated and does not include your prompt content or personally identifiable information.
[Placeholder: Update this section with your specific analytics tool, e.g., Plausible, Vercel Analytics, or remove if not applicable.]

sections.heading: 4. No Third-Party Data Selling
paragraphs: We do not sell, trade, or rent any user data to third parties. This applies regardless of whether the data was collected through the generator or through the Community Gallery.

sections.heading: 5. Community Gallery Submissions
paragraphs: If you submit a prompt to the Community Gallery, that prompt becomes publicly visible to other users of the application. You should not include personally identifiable information, confidential content, or proprietary data in any Gallery submission. We may review submissions for moderation purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Orxis is deployed on Vercel and uses Airtable to store Community Gallery submissions. Each service operates under its own privacy policy and data handling practices. We recommend reviewing them independently:
list: Vercel Privacy Policy — vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy
Airtable Privacy Policy — airtable.com/privacy

sections.heading: 7. Data Security
paragraphs: We follow standard practices for securing the data we handle. That said, no system connected to the internet can be guaranteed fully secure. We recommend not submitting anything sensitive or confidential to the Community Gallery.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as the application evolves. Significant changes will be reflected in the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of Orxis after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
paragraphs: For questions or concerns about this policy, contact us at <1>orxis.app@gmail.com</1>.

privacy.footerNote: Orxis is operated under the laws of Thailand. This policy does not constitute legal advice.
